verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-search data API. Its MCP evidence covers only the server role: agents such as Cursor, Claude and ChatGPT connect to Channel3. Plugging third-party MCP servers into a catalog API so it can call their tools is outside this product's category. Nothing in the pack shows Channel3 acting as an MCP client or tool host, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
